name: coverage-edge-match-inline
body: coverage_check's edge-derived touched set matches the per-kind operation edges inline (mirroring plan_add_task_at) instead of reusing render's private task_op_edge helper — publishing that helper would modify the unplanned render unit. The edge-derived path also has no direct unit fixture yet: the existing coverage fixtures carry only legacy fields and exercise the fallback. Upgrade: consolidate the shared edge matcher and add direct edge-path fixtures when a plan task covers the render unit or task-8 rewrites the coverage fixtures to edges.
